title: The third can
logline: Three coffee cans on the dock now, each with a spent tube: 2020, 2025, and this year's, bought with the coins from the tin's lid. The page counts. Three.

panels.composition: Three coffee cans in a row on dock planks each holding a spent firework tube, the oldest faded and the newest fresh, the lawn chair behind.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, three coffee cans in a row on wooden dock planks each holding a single spent cardboard firework tube from faded to fresh, an old lawn chair behind, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
